body.message:
Good morning Jannit,

We completely understand your concern. Please be assured that we are a reputable company, and you may also verify our details through our official website. The payment link shared with you is safe and secure.

However, if you prefer not to make the payment online, you are welcome to visit our main office and complete the payment by cash or card.

Our office is open today from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and you may visit us anytime during these hours.

Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to assisting you.
